label: Latitude 5440 14-inch business laptop
description: 14-inch 13th-gen Core business laptop with a real RJ45 port plus two Thunderbolt 4 ports and Wi-Fi 6E.
notes: Real RJ45 onboard at 1GbE (Intel I219-LM) - no dongle needed, which is exactly what separates it from the XPS line. Wi-Fi 6E AX211 is the secondary path; ideal 'office laptop that actually has a port' node.
